statement: The NVIDIA H200 NVL accelerator card is shown on Newegg as out of stock and coming soon with no price listed, while the older H100 PCIe card is in stock.
why: Retail unavailability of the newer part alongside availability of the prior generation is a weak but same-day sign that current-generation channel supply is still tight.

impact.mechanism: No sellable retail inventory of the newer accelerator indicates channel allocation is absorbed upstream, lengthening effective availability for small buyers.

evidence.excerpt: Status: 'Out of Stock - Coming Soon' with an 'Auto Notify' option available (no price listed while out of stock)

confidence.basis: One retailer's stock status is a thin proxy for lead times; no quoted lead-time figure exists in the document.
